_comment: Facts about this adapter that its probe response cannot carry: display names, maturity, and the engine versions CI actually restores from. Everything the probe declares (adapter version, engine id, source kinds, pitr) is read from testdata/probe_response.golden instead — never duplicated here. The capabilities generator fails if the source names below do not match the probe exactly, and the integration suite restores from the images listed under verified — the baseline on every run, the rest in the scheduled version matrix and before a release tag — so neither can drift. The official cassandra images idle under `command: sleep infinity` with no wrapper (their entrypoint passes non-cassandra commands through, measured); the adapter prepares the node for a zero-ingress sandbox itself. The baseline is the 4.1 line, the older of the two maintained series and the one most estates run. See docs/capabilities.md and docs/engine-versions.md.
name: Apache Cassandra

sources.cassandra_snapshot_tar: One tar archive (plain or gzip) of a collected snapshot, keyspaces at the root or under one wrapping directory
sources.cassandra_snapshot: One collected snapshot tree: `<keyspace>/<table>/` holding each table's `snapshots/<tag>/` contents
sources.cassandra_snapshot_dir: A directory of collected snapshot trees; the one whose own manifests claim the newest instant is restored
